 CAN FIN HOMES — MARGINS & FUNDING
• Spread Guidance: 2.75%+.
• NIM Guidance: 3.75%+.

missed_deltas.benchmark_text:
🟢
 CAN FIN HOMES — ASSET QUALITY UPDATE
• Q2 Prepayments: ₹1,795 Cr vs ₹1,857 Cr in Q1.
• Credit Cost Guidance: ~10 bps.
• Q2 Credit Cost Run Rate: ~9 bps.
• H1 GNPA Increase: ₹35 Cr vs ₹40 Cr in the previous year.
• Management expects GNPA to improve in H2, potentially easing provisioning pressure.
📌
 PREPAYMENT TREND
Monthly prepayments declined from ₹655 Cr in July to below ₹600 Cr in both August and September.
Management believes narrowing differences in lending rates could support better customer retention.
⚠️
 A slight rise in SMA-0 was attributed partly to the new system's daily overdue-recognition method.

CHAIRMAN NOEL TATA TATA TRUSTS FY26 ANNUAL REPORT
Tata Trusts guided by a simple idea: to do what India needs.
Our founders did not set out to build the largest group of companies.
Founders believed enterprise carried a social responsibility.
True progress meant improving people's quality of life.
There are moments an institution must relook its own role.
Need more institutions in India capable of nurturing talent.
Giving young people opportunities without having to look elsewhere.
May seek partnerships with philanthropies, like-minded organizations.
Continue to support families facing medical crises.
Strengthening distributed cancer care to bring it closer to home.
Building a nationwide network of 40-50 not-for-profit general hospitals.
Model that allows those who can afford to pay for care help make quality treatment accessible to those who cannot.
Measure philanthropy by impact, not reach or spending.
Must be able to show, in meaningful and measurable terms.
Remain conscious every rupee entrusted to us carries a responsibility.
Tata Trusts disbursed ₹1,556.31 crore ($167.35 million) in FY26.

 CAN FIN HOMES — ASSET QUALITY UPDATE
• Q2 Prepayments: ₹1,795 Cr vs ₹1,857 Cr in Q1.
• Credit Cost Guidance: ~10 bps.

CHAIRMAN NOEL TATA TATA TRUSTS FY26 ANNUAL REPORT
Tata Trusts guided by a simple idea: to do what India needs.
Our founders did not set out to build the largest group of companies.
Founders believed enterprise carried a social responsibility.
True progress meant improving people's quality of life.
There are moments an institution must relook its own role.
Need more institutions in India capable of nurturing talent.
Giving young people opportunities without having to look elsewhere.
May seek partnerships with philanthropies, like-minded organizations.
Continue to support families facing medical crises.
Strengthening distributed cancer care to bring it closer to home.
Building a nationwide network of 40-50 not-for-profit general hospitals.
Model that allows those who can afford to pay for care help make quality treatment accessible to those who cannot.
Measure philanthropy by impact, not reach or spending.
Must be able to show, in meaningful and measurable terms.
Remain conscious every rupee entrusted to us carries a responsibility.
Tata Trusts disbursed ₹1,556.31 crore ($167.35 million) in FY26.

The aggressive positioning comes just days before the Jio Platforms IPO, which could become a major value-unlocking event for Reliance.
